# Assassination/Subtlety hybrid Rogue — Raid (group)

[Rogue](../README.md) > [Raid (group)](README.md) > Assassination/Subtlety hybrid

**[Assassination/Subtlety hybrid — Raid](../research/raid/builds/hybrid-assassination-subtlety-open-raid.md)** (27/2/22) — [open the talent tree](https://talentsforever.com/rogue/60/0053031121045101-02-2052210313010011-12)

> 🔬 Derived build: found by this project's open talent search (every legal build, no tree rule, in the community's raid simulator in a full raid, raced against the rotation's builds). A model of the beta, to check at launch.

## How to play

**Before the pull:** **Premeditation**.

**Keep up all fight:** **Slice and Dice**.

**Then press the first one that is ready**, top to bottom:

1. **Garrote**: keep it on the target (timing: see below)
2. **Vanish** (timing: see below); no global cooldown, so press it alongside the others
3. **Preparation**
4. **Shank** (timing: see below)
5. **Premeditation** when you have 3 or fewer combo points; no global cooldown, so press it alongside the others
6. **Rupture**: keep it on the target, when you have 3 or more combo points (timing: see below)
7. **Eviscerate** (rank 8) when you have 5 combo points (timing: see below)
8. **Ghostly Strike** when Garrote has under 4 seconds left (timing: see below)
9. **Hemorrhage**

**Hemorrhage** is your filler: cast it whenever nothing above is ready.

*The simulator's full rotation for this build, with every condition: [research rotation page](../research/raid/rotation.md).*
